description: Restricted endogamous founder priors derived from focused_amenhotep_tiye_children_l1_l2_founders by concentrating each locus on the observed/listed allele pool and capping 'other' mass. Explicit person-specific founder genotype priors are removed.

allele_frequency_parameters.other_policy: The listed table priors often sum to less than 1. The remaining mass is stored as allele 'other' after replacing raw zero priors with allele_floor_epsilon0.
